from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

target = "DEV-PRED-CONTROL-CENTER-E006-DIAG-20261005-E007"
home = Path.home()
report_path = (
    home
    / ".local/share/prediction-project-executor/worktrees"
    / target
    / "diagnostic-result/control-center-e006-test-diagnostic.json"
)
if not report_path.is_file() or report_path.is_symlink():
    print("CONTROL_CENTER_E007_READ MISSING", flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(1)
data = json.loads(report_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
summary = data.get("summary") or {}
issue = summary.get("first_issue") or {}
out = {
    "tests_run": summary.get("tests_run"),
    "failures": summary.get("failures"),
    "errors": summary.get("errors"),
    "successful": summary.get("successful"),
    "first_test": issue.get("test"),
    "first_traceback": issue.get("traceback"),
}
print("CONTROL_CENTER_E007_READ " + json.dumps(out, separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0)
